identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase Ⅰ Study Evaluating Safety and Efficacy of C-CAR088 Treatment in Subjects With Relapsed or Refractory Multiple Myeloma

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The study will include the following sequential phases: Screening, Pre- Treatment (Cell Product Preparation, Lymphodepleting Chemotherapy), C-CAR088 infusion and Follow-up.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Safety: The incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs)
primaryOutcomes.description: The incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs)

secondaryOutcomes.description: ORR(including sCR / CR / VGPR / PR, based on IMWG 2016 efficacy evaluation criteria)
PFS(based on IMWG 2016 efficacy evaluation criteria)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The CART cell duration in vivo
secondaryOutcomes.description: The copys of BCMA-CART DNA in peripheral blood with qPCR method

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The soluble BCMA changes in peripheral blood
secondaryOutcomes.description: The amount of soluble BCMA in peripheral blood with ELISA method
